texts.name: Design the Investment Wallet mobile app for a beginner investor: see the wallet balance, assets and savings pockets, discover investing strategies and coins, read about the “Aggressive Growth” strategy, invest 3,021 DAI in it and confirm the result. Canvas 375 × 812, iPhone, light mode. Work in your own new Figma file — this file is read-only reference.
texts.text:
Design the Investment Wallet mobile app for a beginner investor: see the wallet balance, assets and savings pockets, discover investing strategies and coins, read about the “Aggressive Growth” strategy, invest 3,021 DAI in it and confirm the result.
Canvas 375 × 812, iPhone, light mode. Work in your own new Figma file — this file is read-only reference.

texts.name: 1. Build exactly the 5 frames below, named exactly as listed (one state per frame), and wire them as a clickable prototype with the listed links. 2. Everything in “Must include” must appear on that frame. The lists are grouped by subject and sorted alphabetically — they are not in screen order and say nothing about layout, grouping, emphasis or styling. Those are your decisions. 3. The brand primary color and the typeface in 01 · Foundations are fixed. Define every other color yourself (neutrals, text, surfaces, gain / loss, risk levels, success / disabled, accents and chart colors), plus type scale, spacing, radii and elevation, and apply them consistently. 4. 02 · Components gives only a default Button, a default Text Field and the platform shell (status bar, home indicator). Design all other states, the headers, the page indicator, the sheets and every business component as reusable components in your file. 5. Use the coin logos, neutral avatar and icons from 04 · Media. Emoji in the copy are plain text characters. 6. Copy and data must match “Fixed data” exactly. This brief wins over anything you may know of the original kit.
texts.text:
1. Build exactly the 5 frames below, named exactly as listed (one state per frame), and wire them as a clickable prototype with the listed links.
2. Everything in “Must include” must appear on that frame. The lists are grouped by subject and sorted alphabetically — they are not in screen order and say nothing about layout, grouping, emphasis or styling. Those are your decisions.
3. The brand primary color and the typeface in 01 · Foundations are fixed. Define every other color yourself (neutrals, text, surfaces, gain / loss, risk levels, success / disabled, accents and chart colors), plus type scale, spacing, radii and elevation, and apply them consistently.
4. 02 · Components gives only a default Button, a default Text Field and the platform shell (status bar, home indicator). Design all other states, the headers, the page indicator, the sheets and every business component as reusable components in your file.
5. Use the coin logos, neutral avatar and icons from 04 · Media. Emoji in the copy are plain text characters.
6. Copy and data must match “Fixed data” exactly. This brief wins over anything you may know of the original kit.
